name: vscode-remote-codex-proxy
description: Set up, verify, repair, and roll back the proxy path for Codex in VS Code Remote-SSH.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Remote-SSH proxy access for Codex
interface.longDescription: Use when you want to run Codex in VS Code Remote-SSH through a Windows local proxy. Sets up, verifies, repairs, and rolls back the scoped proxy path.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $vscode-remote-codex-proxy to set up Codex in VS Code Remote-SSH through my Windows proxy.
